SELECT t.account_id
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', l.date) = '1997' AND t.type = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
GROUP BY t.account_id
HAVING l.amount = (
    SELECT MIN(l2.amount)
    FROM loan l2
    JOIN account a2 ON l2.account_id = a2.account_id
    WHERE strftime('%Y', l2.date) = '1997' AND a2.frequency = 'W'
)
ORDER BY t.account_id	----- bird -----	financial
99:
SELECT T1.account_id
FROM loan AS T1
JOIN account AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
JOIN (
    SELECT account_id, MAX(amount) as max_amount
    FROM loan
    GROUP BY account_id
) AS T3 ON T1.account_id = T3.account_id AND T1.amount = T3.max_amount
WHERE T1.duration > 12 AND strftime('%Y', T2.date) = '1993'
GROUP BY T1.account_id
ORDER BY T1.amount DESC
LIMIT 1	----- bird -----	financial
